answer: Identity bonds decay: each identity posts a 40 POA bond losing 2 POA per epoch unless it earns honestly, so bonds need refills. A saffron trader posts one bond and earns it back. A walnut grower on a remote island posts one too, and trade covers its refill. Minting 100 fakes costs 4,000 POA plus 200 POA per epoch against a ~900 POA pool, so the farm loses money from day one. Honest agents pay once, keep earning, and are never diluted by fakes.
